pages.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished 1024x1536 portrait comic page for the Spanish fantasy comic 'Dos Parkinson y Medio'. Warm colorful expressive cartoon ink-and-paint art matching the reference style, cream gutters, crisp black panel frames, readable large Spanish lettering with correct accents. Western reading order, clear panel divisions for each successive moment. Only exact quoted script text is printed. Narration in cream rectangles, speech in white balloons with tails to the named speaker. No watermark or extra writing.
NEW LOCATION: bright welcoming workshop classroom on Hogwarts fifth floor, big windows with autumn sunshine, neutral cream/sage colors, fluffy floor cushions, a shelf of cloth tote bags, plastic practice dolls, bottles and folded diapers. These are props for a fantasy school project; no real infants appear. No clinical examinations, no pregnancy or bodily transformations.
Wardrobe changed for this workshop: all pupils wear LOOSE OPAQUE BLACK LONG-SLEEVED SCHOOL SWEATSHIRTS and LONG BLACK TRACK PANTS, simple house crests and house-color piping, ordinary flat shoes. No school robes or neckties during workshop. Hermione Gryffindor burgundy/gold piping, very voluminous curly brown hair, brown eyes, freckles. Pansy Slytherin green/silver piping, chin-length straight BLACK bob, GREEN eyes. Daphne long blonde hair, green/silver. Blaise Black with short curly black hair, green/silver. Lavender long blonde curls with BURGUNDY hair bow and burgundy/gold piping.
NEW ADULT INSTRUCTOR BLAIR CONWAY: friendly adult woman in her thirties, BLUE eyes, shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair tied in a low ponytail, opaque navy high-neck long-sleeved professional tunic and navy trousers. She is distinct from silver-haired Elsie. No sensual posing, eye-level ordinary classroom compositions.
References supply Hermione/Pansy faces and general style only, not outfits or setting.

Reference 2 (chapter4 page1) fixes Blair's face, chestnut ponytail, blue eyes, navy turtleneck outfit, classroom and all BLACK LONG-SLEEVED TRACKSUITS WITH LONG PANTS. Preserve them. Additional cast only if called for: Mandy has straight shoulder-length black hair, gray eyes, Ravenclaw blue/bronze piping; Sophie has shoulder-length honey-blonde hair, brown eyes, yellow/black piping. Dean is Black with short curly black hair, burgundy/gold piping; Seamus has short tousled chestnut hair, burgundy/gold. Draco platinum-blond, gray eyes, green/silver; Astoria long straight dark chestnut hair, gray eyes, green/silver. The third reference supplies Sophie's face only; replace her old robe with the workshop tracksuit. Harry and Ron are absent.
Small header exactly 'Capítulo 4 · 07'. Follow 9 sequential scenes. Only conversations and a fantasy magic vial experiment appear, no anatomical imagery, no pregnancies, no bodily changes. Colored 'essences' are abstract magical LIGHT inside a glass vial, not any body substance. Do not show a baby portrait or a physical baby resulting from mixing the lights. The result will later customize a toy.
SCENE SCRIPT:
1. Pansy reclama, aunque está nerviosa: «Granger, no tengo todo el día.» Hermione toma un cabello de sus rizos y lo coloca en el vial.
2. Viñeta grande del frasco. Dos luces de colores se mueven, se acercan y se fusionan como una pequeña estrella. Cartela: «Sus esencias parecían ponerse de acuerdo.»
3. El líquido se vuelve dorado y tranquilo. Pansy murmura: «Wow, eso fue…» Hermione completa: «Asombroso.»
4. Blair pide al grupo: «Etiqueten los frascos con sus nombres y tráiganlos al frente. Con cuidado.»
5. Hermione escribe «Hermione Granger / Pansy Parkinson» en la etiqueta del vial dorado y lo entrega. Pansy la espera sentada, todavía seria.
6. Hermione regresa al cojín. Pansy propone con tono de negocios: «¿Cuánto quieres por beber la poción de la simulación?» Hermione replica: «¿Por qué piensas que la tomaré yo?»
7. Pansy responde: «No pienso hacerlo. Sin dormir bien tendría un humor horrible.» Hermione contesta: «Yo tampoco quiero pasar por esos síntomas. Tendrás que hacerlo tú.»
8. Pansy insiste: «Tú pasas por esas dos semanas y yo te doy una suma considerable de galeones.» Hermione dice firme: «No me interesa tu dinero. No todo se resuelve así.»
9. Pansy esboza una sonrisa burlona: «Todo se resuelve con dinero. Es mejor obtener algo por tu sacrificio. Intento hacer esto bien.» No resolver la discusión todavía.
